headline: How many years together before he makes a commitment?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, yet your hand found the one ready for a decision.
Every tool is out, and both hands are at work.
You asked how many years together come before commitment. The readiness on this table is what catches me.
He has not made the commitment, though the relationship has years behind it.
Something has hold of the decision, keeping readiness from becoming commitment. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the decision…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing the card and found the one made still by a single rope.
One rope circles one ankle. Nothing else is tied.
You asked for the length of the suspension. This card makes me look at the one rope.
Still, the future is held while the count grows in your question.
Right where the years would become an answer, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what has hold of this…
c: You turned the Fool. The picture was hidden, but your hand went to the one already on the road.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked how many years pass before he decides. The beginning on this card holds my attention.
But the relationship moves through time without settling the commitment.
I keep coming back to something between the relationship and commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me see what is doing this…
